package store

// Golden generator for cliproxy-rs: requests signed by minio-go's SigV4 signer.
// RUST_GOLDEN=<file> go test -run TestRustGoldenSigV4 ./internal/store/

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"github.com/minio/minio-go/v7/pkg/signer"
)

func TestRustGoldenSigV4(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("RUST_GOLDEN")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("RUST_GOLDEN not set")
	}
	type tc struct {
		Method  string            `json:"method"`
		URL     string            `json:"url"`
		Headers map[string]string `json:"headers"`
		Region  string            `json:"region"`
	}
	empty := "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855"
	cases := []tc{
		{"HEAD", "http://127.0.0.1:9000/cpa-bucket", map[string]string{"X-Amz-Content-Sha256": empty}, "us-east-1"},
		{"GET", "http://127.0.0.1:9000/cpa-bucket?location=", map[string]string{"X-Amz-Content-Sha256": empty}, "us-east-1"},
		{"GET", "http://127.0.0.1:9000/cpa-bucket?list-type=2&prefix=auths%2F&continuation-token=a+b%2Fc%3D&fetch-owner=true", map[string]string{"X-Amz-Content-Sha256": empty}, "eu-west-1"},
		{"PUT", "https://s3.example.com/cpa-bucket/auths/team%20a/%C3%BC%2Bx.json", map[string]string{"X-Amz-Content-Sha256": "5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592ae8fbaa1fa3dc0d65ff1ac1b5d2ac57d", "Content-Type": "application/json"}, "us-east-1"},
		{"DELETE", "http://minio.local:9000/b/config/config.yaml", map[string]string{"X-Amz-Content-Sha256": empty}, "us-east-1"},
		{"PUT", "http://127.0.0.1:9000/new-bucket", map[string]string{"X-Amz-Content-Sha256": empty}, "us-east-1"},
	}
	var results []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases {
		u, err := url.Parse(c.URL)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		req := http.Request{Method: c.Method, URL: u, Header: http.Header{}, Host: u.Host}
		for k, v := range c.Headers {
			req.Header.Set(k, v)
		}
		signed := signer.SignV4(req, "AKIAEXAMPLE", "secret/key+EXAMPLE", "", c.Region)
		var names []string
		for k := range signed.Header {
			names = append(names, k)
		}
		sort.Strings(names)
		headers := map[string]string{}
		for _, k := range names {
			headers[k] = signed.Header.Get(k)
		}
		results = append(results, map[string]any{"case": c, "signed_headers": headers, "raw_query": signed.URL.RawQuery})
	}
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(results, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(raw, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
